parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activity rows against human single-protein target CHEMBL260 (MAPK14). Join molecule_dictionary, activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL260, target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and non-null pChEMBL value. Require compound_structures as an INNER JOIN. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID.
